{{Top|leg}}
'''Power plates''' were vital components in the [[Farendress Defel Exports]] [[HR-1200]]. They contained cultures of micro-organisms that fed on [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]. When used in the HR-1200, it absorbed heat from the surrounding area, generating electricity which was stored in [[Battery/Legends|battery]] cells.
